source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI), Adi Parva, Astika sub-parva, adhyaya 14 (Vinata breaks an egg; Aruna, half-formed, curses her to five hundred years of slavery unless his brother frees her, and becomes the charioteer of the Sun). Told out of the CE's order (see SERIES.md, arc A02).
structure: Every episode: RECAP (≈3 s; KIT.series.recapStrip) → HOOK (one question, Sauti at the Naimisha fire; the episode title follows it: KIT.series.episodeTitle) → STORY → NEXT (a cliffhanger line, then the teaser card: KIT.series.nextTeaser).

voice.note: speaker → script/cast.json (voice, speed, pitch). Per line: speed (× the speaker's), pre/post (ms of silence before/after the voice), say (what is spoken, if not `text`). captionY (px or "high") lifts the caption above low action.

lines.text: Kadru's thousand eggs hatched. Vinata's two did not.
lines.say: Kadru's thousand eggs hatched. [p:150] Vinata's two did not.
lines.note: RECAP. Episode 9's key image as a memory: Kadru's jars cracking, small serpents rising; Vinata kneeling by her two silent jars. beats = 'hatched', 'two'

lines.speaker: sauti
lines.text: What would a mother do, who could not wait?
lines.note: HOOK (Sauti at the Naimisha fire, close). In the smoke a woman's hand hovers over a glowing egg. beats = 'mother', 'wait'; the title in the post

lines.text: Ashamed before her sister, Vinata broke one of her eggs.
lines.say: Ashamed before her sister… [p:100] Vinata broke one of her eggs.
lines.note: STORY 1. Kashyapa's hermitage, a cold grey dawn. Kadru passes behind with her serpent sons; Vinata, alone, lifts the rose-red egg from its jar and on 'broke' (beats[2]) it cracks open in her hands, red light pouring out. beats = 'Ashamed' (Kadru's sons glance), 'Vinata', 'broke'

lines.text: Inside was a son: his upper body formed, his lower body not.
lines.say: Inside was a son: [p:150] his upper body formed… [p:100] his lower body not.
lines.note: STORY 2. Close: from the broken shell rises a young man of red light, beautiful from the waist up, and below the waist only light and mist. beats = 'son' (he rises), 'formed', 'not' (the light thins away below)
STORY 3. His name in gold, with 'the red of dawn'; he opens his eyes

lines.speaker: aruna
lines.text: Mother, for your haste, you will be your rival's slave for five hundred years.
lines.say: Mother… [p:100] for your haste, [p:100] you will be your rival's slave… [p:100] for five hundred years.
lines.note: STORY 4 (Aruna speaks). He raises his hand over her; she falls to her knees; behind her Kadru's shadow grows long, and on 'slave' (beats[2]) Vinata's ornaments fall away, the end of her sari over her head; on 'hundred' a year-counter. beats = 'Mother', 'haste', 'slave', 'hundred'

lines.speaker: aruna
lines.text: Do not break my brother's egg. Wait, and he will set you free.
lines.say: Do not break my brother's egg. [p:200] Wait… and he will set you free.
lines.note: STORY 5 (Aruna speaks, gentler). He points to the gold egg in its jar, glowing; on 'free' (beats[2]) the gold light pulses like a heartbeat. beats = 'brother's', 'Wait', 'free'

lines.text: Then Aruna rose into the sky, to drive the chariot of the Sun.
lines.say: Then Aruna rose into the sky… [p:100] to drive the chariot of the Sun.
lines.note: STORY 6. He rises into the grey sky; the Sun's chariot comes over the eastern ridge: a great gold disc drawn by seven horses of light; Aruna takes the reins. beats = 'Aruna', 'rose', 'Sun'

lines.text: He is the red of every dawn.
lines.note: STORY 7. Wide: the whole sky flushes red and rose and gold from the horizon up; on the earth below, Vinata looks up, the gold egg beside her. beats = 'is', 'dawn' (the red floods the sky)

lines.text: Then the sisters saw a horse rise from the ocean, and made a wager.
lines.say: Then the sisters saw a horse rise from the ocean… [p:150] and made a wager.
lines.note: NEXT 1. The two sisters on a shore at sunrise; from the shining ocean a white horse rises; Kadru points at its tail. beats = 'horse', 'ocean', 'wager'

lines.text: Next: The Horse from the Ocean.
lines.say: Next: [p:200] The Horse from the Ocean.
lines.note: the teaser card, with a glimpse of episode 11: the white horse Uchchaihshravas rising from the ocean of milk
